title: 8 Signs a Godly Man's Impulses Don't Run the Show
caption:
Willpower in the moment is the weakest kind. His decisions were made the night before.

A man who runs his life isn't the guy with the most self-control at 11 p.m., he's the guy who decided before the moment showed up: what he'd say in anger, what he'd spend, when the phone goes down.

"Like a city whose walls are broken through is a person who lacks self-control." Proverbs 25:28

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #selfcontrol #discipline
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
